title.target: Past modals: criticism, regret and necessity
title.en: Past modals: criticism, regret and necessity

ex.t: He gave me a reproachful look.
The accident was caused by sheer negligence.
That decision was a regrettable mistake.
There was no need for such unnecessary haste.
A little care could have prevented the accident.
ex.ko: 조금만 주의했더라면 사고를 예방할 수 있었을 거예요.

ex.t: She took responsibility for the error.
That was a reckless thing to do.
I realised too late that I was wrong.
ex.ko: 나는 뒤늦게 내가 틀렸다는 것을 깨달았어요.

ex.t: I learned a valuable lesson from this.

title.ko: 과거 조동사: should have · ought to have · needn't have · could have + p.p.
title.en: past modals: should have, ought to have, needn't have, could have + past participle

explain.ko: 과거 조동사는 지나간 일에 대한 비판, 후회, 추측을 나타냅니다. should have / ought to have + 과거분사는 하지 않은 일에 대한 비판이나 후회를, shouldn't have + 과거분사는 한 일에 대한 후회를 나타냅니다. needn't have + 과거분사는 '했지만 필요는 없었다'는 뜻이고, could have + 과거분사는 가능했지만 하지 않았던 일을 말합니다. was supposed to는 기대나 계획이 지켜지지 않았을 때 씁니다.
explain.en: Past modals express criticism, regret and speculation about the past. Should have and ought to have + past participle criticise or regret something not done; shouldn't have + past participle regrets something done. Needn't have + past participle means you did it but it was unnecessary, and could have + past participle names a possible action you did not take. Was supposed to is used when an expectation or plan was not met.

head: 표현 / Form
의미 / Meaning
예문 / Example
rows: 하지 않은 일에 대한 비판·후회 / criticism, regret
한 일에 대한 후회 / regret about an action
You needn't have brought a gift.
We could have taken the train.

notes.ko: needn't have는 이미 했던 일에 쓰고, didn't need to는 했는지 알 수 없을 때도 씁니다.
notes.en: Needn't have is for something already done; didn't need to does not say whether it was done.

notes.ko: ought to have는 should have보다 약간 격식적입니다.
notes.en: Ought to have is slightly more formal than should have.

notes.ko: 비판할 때는 어조가 강해질 수 있으니 상황에 맞게 완곡하게 말하세요.
notes.en: Criticism can sound harsh, so soften it to suit the situation.

examples.t: You ought to have phoned in advance.
You needn't have come so early.
With a little care, it could have been avoided.
examples.ko: 조금만 조심했더라면 막을 수 있었을 거예요.

examples.t: He was supposed to attend the meeting but never showed up.
examples.ko: 그가 회의에 오기로 되어 있었는데 나타나지 않았어요.

practice.q: You ___ phoned me earlier; I was worried.
You ___ bought so much food; we have plenty.
We ___ taken a taxi, but we walked instead.
He ___ to attend, but he never arrived.

lines.t: How could the accident have been prevented?

trans.ko: (질문) 그 사고는 어떻게 예방할 수 있었을까요?

options: A little care could have prevented it.
A little care will prevent it.

lines.t: What would you say about being late for the meeting?

trans.ko: (질문) 회의에 늦은 것에 대해 뭐라고 말하겠어요?

lines.t: Didn't you know the report was due yesterday?
I did, but I sent the wrong file. I should have checked again.
It's fine. You needn't have worried so much. The manager gave us another day.
Really? Then I needn't have stayed up all night.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 보고서 마감인 걸 몰랐어?
B: 알고 있었는데 파일을 잘못 보냈어. 다시 확인했어야 했어.
A: 괜찮아, 그렇게 걱정할 필요는 없었어. 팀장님이 하루 더 주셨거든.
B: 정말? 그럼 밤새 쓸 필요도 없었네.

questions.q: Why didn't the woman need to worry?

lines.t: This project ran well behind schedule. We should have checked the risks at the start. We could also have updated the team more often. Still, this experience will help us manage the next project better.

trans.ko: 이번 프로젝트는 일정이 많이 늦어졌습니다. 우리는 초기에 위험 요소를 점검했어야 했습니다. 팀원들에게 더 자주 상황을 공유할 수도 있었고요. 그래도 이번 경험으로 다음 프로젝트는 더 잘 관리할 수 있을 것입니다.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the project?
options: Risks should have been checked at the start

lines.t: I think I should have kept learning an instrument when I was young.
Is it too late to start now?
No, it isn't. I just shouldn't have given up back then.

trans.ko:
진행자: 오늘의 주제는 후회입니다.
손님: 저는 젊을 때 악기를 계속 배웠어야 했다고 생각해요.
진행자: 지금 시작하기엔 늦었을까요?
손님: 아니요, 늦지 않았어요. 다만 그때 포기하지 말았어야 했죠.

questions.q: The guest should have kept learning an ______
The guest believes it is not too ______

items.passage:
1) You ___ phoned earlier.
2) You ___ hurried so much.
3) He ___ to come, but he never turned up.

trans.ko: 1) 너는 더 일찍 전화했어야 했어. 2) 그렇게 서두를 필요는 없었어. 3) 그는 오기로 되어 있었는데 나타나지 않았어.

questions.q: He ___ to come, but he never turned up.

items.passage: Last month our team missed an important contract. Looking back, we (1) have reviewed the documents more carefully. We (2) have revised them all night before the deadline, but anxiety kept us going. Now I think this mistake was a valuable (3).

trans.ko: 지난달 우리 팀은 중요한 계약을 놓쳤어요. 돌이켜 보면 서류를 좀 더 꼼꼼히 검토했어야 했어요. 마감 전날 밤새 수정할 필요는 없었지만, 불안해서 멈출 수 없었어요. 지금은 이 실수가 소중한 교훈이 되었다고 생각해요.

items.passage:
COMPANY NEWS
Power failure report
A power cut in the server room last weekend stopped the service for three hours. Checks showed the cause was an old battery in the backup power unit. The person in charge admitted they should have checked the replacement date in advance. The company will now strengthen its regular inspection schedule.

trans.ko:
사내 소식
정전 사고 보고
지난 주말 서버실의 정전으로 서비스가 세 시간 중단되었다. 점검 결과 백업 전원 장치의 배터리가 오래된 것이 원인이었다. 담당자는 교체 시기를 미리 확인했어야 했다고 인정했다. 회사는 앞으로 정기 점검 일정을 강화하기로 했다.

questions.q: What caused the service to stop?
What will the company do next?

items.passage: Michael stayed up all night before his presentation. Now he regrets not starting earlier. One colleague offered to help, but he refused.

trans.ko: 마이클은 발표 전날 밤을 새웠다. 그는 지금 더 일찍 시작했어야 했다고 후회한다. 그의 동료 한 명이 도와주겠다고 했지만 그는 거절했다.

questions.q: Michael stayed up all night before the presentation.
Michael accepted help from a colleague.

expressions.t: You should have told me in advance.
You needn't have rushed that much.
I ought to have been more careful, and I apologise.
expressions.ko: 제가 좀 더 신중했어야 했는데, 정말 죄송합니다.

expressions.t: We could have avoided being late if we'd left earlier.
expressions.ko: 조금만 일찍 출발했더라면 늦지 않았을 거예요.

expressions.t: He must have known, yet he said nothing.
expressions.ko: 그 사람은 분명히 알고 있었을 텐데도 말하지 않았어요.

expressions.t: It may well have been for the best; how could we know?
expressions.ko: 그게 최선이었을 수도 있어요. 우리가 어떻게 알겠어요?

expressions.t: Had I known better, I would have acted differently.
expressions.ko: 그때 더 잘 알았더라면 달리 행동했을 거예요.

expressions.t: I've learned my lesson; next time will be different.
expressions.ko: 이번 일에서 교훈을 얻었으니 다음에는 다를 거예요.

prompt.ko: 과거의 실수를 되돌아보며 should have, needn't have, could have를 사용해 4문장을 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Reflect on a past mistake and write 4 sentences using should have, needn't have and could have.

task.model: I only prepared my presentation the night before. I should have started earlier. I needn't have stayed up all night revising, but I was anxious. I could have asked a colleague for help, but I didn't. I learned a valuable lesson from this.

model_trans.ko: 저는 프레젠테이션 자료를 전날 밤에야 준비했어요. 더 일찍 시작했어야 했어요. 밤새 수정할 필요는 없었는데 불안해서 그랬어요. 동료에게 도움을 청할 수도 있었지만 그러지 않았어요. 이번 일에서 큰 교훈을 얻었어요.
model_trans.en: I only prepared my presentation the night before. I should have started earlier. I needn't have stayed up all night revising, but I was anxious. I could have asked a colleague for help, but I didn't. I learned a valuable lesson from this.
